mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orgId, o.org_name AS orgName, o.org_type AS orgType, uo.org_role AS orgRole FROM t_user_org uo JOIN t_org o ON uo.org_id = o.id WHERE uo.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.id AS postId, p.post_name AS postName, pp.support_name AS supportName,
s.id AS sectionId, s.org_name AS sectionName, up.line AS line FROM t_user_post up JOIN t_post p ON up.post_id = p.id JOIN t_post pp ON up.support_id = pp.id JOIN t_org s ON up.section_id = s.id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, uo.org_role AS orgRole FROM t_user_org uo JOIN t_user u ON uo.user_id = u.id WHERE uo.org_id = #{orgId}

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, u.employee_id AS employeeId,
-- 工段信息（取第一条，若多值可改为聚合） MAX(s.id) AS sectionId, MAX(s.org_name) AS sectionName,
-- 岗位信息（取第一条，若多值可改为聚合） MAX(up.line) AS line, MAX(p.id) AS postId, MAX(p.post_name) AS postName, MAX(pp.post_name) AS supportName
FROM t_user u LEFT JOIN t_user_org uos ON uos.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_org s ON s.id = uos.org_id AND s.org_type = 'section' LEFT JOIN t_user_post up ON up.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_post p ON p.id = up.post_id LEFT JOIN t_post pp ON pp.id = up.support_id
WHERE u.id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.id;

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, u.employee_id AS employeeId,
-- 工段信息（和单人查询逻辑一致：取第一条，MAX聚合） MAX(s.id) AS sectionId, MAX(s.org_name) AS sectionName,
-- 岗位信息（和单人查询逻辑一致：取第一条，MAX聚合） MAX(up.line) AS line, MAX(p.id) AS postId, MAX(p.post_name) AS postName, MAX(pp.post_name) AS supportName
FROM t_user u -- 核心：先筛选出甲班的用户（INNER JOIN确保只返回甲班人员） INNER JOIN ( -- 子查询：获取所有关联甲班的用户ID（去重，避免重复行） SELECT DISTINCT uoc.user_id FROM t_user_org uoc LEFT JOIN t_org c ON c.id = uoc.org_id WHERE c.org_type = 'class' -- 限定是班级类型 AND c.org_name = #{class} -- 筛选甲班 ) AS class_user ON class_user.user_id = u.id
-- 以下关联逻辑和你单人查询完全一致 LEFT JOIN t_user_org uos ON uos.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_org s ON s.id = uos.org_id AND s.org_type = 'section' LEFT JOIN t_user_post up ON up.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_post p ON p.id = up.post_id LEFT JOIN t_post pp ON pp.id = up.support_id
-- 按用户ID分组，确保每个人员只返回一行（和单人查询的GROUP BY逻辑一致） GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.phone, u.employee_id
